run_validate_environment_vptq: run environment validation for VPTQ quantization checking accelerate, vptq, and GPU availability
create_vptq_quantizer: create a VptqHfQuantizer instance with a VptqConfig to enable loading of prequantized transformer models
process_model_before_weight_loading: process a pretrained model by replacing linear layers with VPTQ-compatible linear modules before weight loading
check_is_trainable_vptq: check whether the VPTQ quantized model is trainable returning false since VPTQ quantization is not trainable
check_is_serializable_vptq: check whether the VPTQ quantizer configuration is serializable returning true for saving and loading
